Method of Attack: Sending malicious spam campaigns with email templates pretending to be invoices, reports, voice mails, holiday party invites, or climate change demonstration invites
Emails include malicious attachments that install the trojan when opened
Malicious Word documents with macros that download and execute the trojan
Using infected devices to send further spam and download additional payloads
Indicators of Compromise: Spam campaigns targeting 82 countries, especially the United States
Emails pretending to be proof-of-delivery documents, reports, agreements, and statements
Message prompting to enable editing or content in Word documents
Malicious macros executed upon opening attachments
Spam emails with attached documents or links to download them
